semiconductor_relevance: High — EV Group Korea Ltd. is a leading supplier of wafer processing equipment and solutions for semiconductor and MEMS applications.
summary: EV Group Korea Ltd. specializes in providing advanced wafer processing equipment and solutions for the semiconductor industry, including technologies for wafer bonding, lithography, and metrology. The company focuses on integrating its systems into customer production lines to enhance manufacturing efficiency and support cutting-edge semiconductor designs.

regional_presence.Korea: EV Group has a fully-owned subsidiary in South Korea, supporting local customers and partners.
